result.rationale: Pregnant at 26 weeks with 4 days of ibuprofen use, which FDA advises avoiding after 20 weeks due to fetal kidney/low amniotic fluid risk. She feels well, pain resolved, and fetal movements are normal, so no emergency red flags are reported, but a clinician should assess the exposure, advise stopping ibuprofen, and decide whether amniotic fluid monitoring or follow-up is warranted. This can begin via messaging.
